column1: # Closed-class glue as honest linguistic facts (doctrine: closed-class
# is syntax, and "X is a Y" about the word itself is true data).
# Purpose: glue symbols must EXIST so the novelty tier never crowns
# novel glue over known content (ROMA/CAPITAL/DE class). Low frequency
# keeps Zipf dynamics sane; the census sees live recurrence.
# Curated once, by hand. 12 rows (EL excluded on purpose: the lint
# anaphora rule owns bare EL; edge articles strip structurally anyway).
